description: This file defines a PHP class 'HttpBasicAuthOptionProvider' which extends 'PostAuthOptionProvider'. It provides functionality to generate access token options including HTTP Basic Authentication headers, used in OAuth2 client implementations.

classes.name: HttpBasicAuthOptionProvider
classes.description: Provides OAuth2 access token options with HTTP Basic Authentication headers using client credentials.

methods.name: getAccessTokenOptions
methods.description: Generates access token request options including Authorization header with base64-encoded client credentials.
